QuestionStmt.S: Which of the following dopants is used in germanium to form n-type semiconductor?

Solution.S: To form an n-type semiconductor, germanium (Group 14, 4 valence electrons) must be doped with a Group 15 element having 5 valence electrons. Among the options, Arsenic (As) is a Group 15 element. Hence the correct option is A: As.
